title: Anti-Ragging Committee, Regulations and Zero-Tolerance Policy
content: As per UGC and Supreme Court regulations, Apex Institute maintains a strict Zero-Tolerance Policy against ragging. Ragging in any form inside or outside the college campus or hostels is strictly prohibited and constitutes a criminal offense resulting in immediate expulsion and legal action. 24/7 Anti-Ragging Helpline: 1800-180-5522.
